تصطادوا (form VIII)
# تَصْطَادُوا (taṣṭādū) /tasˤ.tˤaː.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَادَ (iṣṭāda)
# تُصْطَادُوا (tuṣṭādū) /tusˤ.tˤaː.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَادَ (iṣṭāda)
